The founding · Envisioned for Arc

A face. A token.
A new species.

Dehumain begins with a population. Ten thousand AI-generated avatars, each envisioned with a distinct token on Arc. Every identity begins with someone choosing to bring it into existence.

Your NFT is an avatar, a key to the experiences we build, and a birth certificate. In the planned mint, its token is created because you showed up. One face. One token. A founding act recorded onchain.

Our purpose is shared creation: a community building real activity on Arc, with each new identity becoming part of something larger. The founding generation is only the beginning.

Ten thousand identities.
A population with a future.

The King & the Queen

Two origins. Two sovereigns.

Chosen by chance. Witnessed by the population.

I

Generation 01 · DM-KING

One King.

After the male collection closes, one of its 10,000 identities is planned to be selected through a publicly verifiable onchain random draw.

The chosen holder will receive the population’s canonical token: DEHUMAIN.

II

Generation 02 · The counterpart

One Queen.

The female collection follows: 10,000 avatars, each with a distinct token, from DF-0001 to DF-10000.

A second verifiable draw is planned to select the Queen, linked to the second canonical token. A counterpart. A new origin.

The lineage

A new NFT. A new token. A new being.

The Cradle is a future chapter where a male and female Dehumain can combine, with their holders choosing to create a child. Each descendant is envisioned with its own NFT and token, connected to both origins.

+
The Cradle

The work ahead

The founding is only the beginning.

The mint, token creation, sovereign draws and Cradle are planned features. The wider world and tools are still to be built. Tokenomics, breeding mechanics and launch details will follow.

No promise of a floor price, token price or financial return. A shared beginning, and the work to make it real.
